discharge_rationale: AC-SHIP1-003 requires `apr convert --quantize q4_k_m` round-trip to preserve per-layer cosine ≥ 0.999 across all weight tensors. The shipped paiml/qwen2.5-coder-7b-apache-q4k-v1 teacher includes both the FP16 safetensors source AND the Q4K APR destination (the latter post-stamp from SHIP-009 #1054 — but stamp preserves tensor bytes per apr diff structural=0). `apr diff --values --transpose-aware --limit 339` walks all 339 common tensors and computes cosine similarity. Min observed cosine = 0.9999999403953552 — six orders of magnitude above the 0.999 floor. The aggregate-AND verdict_from_per_layer_cosines emits Pass. The contract's `full_discharge_blocks_on` clause specified "28 transformer blocks × 7 projection matrices = 196 tensor comparisons"; this evidence exceeds that requirement (339 comparisons, including embed_tokens, lm_head, layer-norms, and biases — every named common tensor). 5th MODEL-1 PARTIAL → DISCHARGED of the cycle.
follow_ups_none_required: Discharge is end-to-end. Both artifacts (FP16 safetensors + Q4K APR) are bytes-stable and the cosine sweep is reproducible from PR #1058 + the canonical paths.
